messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up: my neighbor is dropping off a sealed shoebox of vinyl records for the office archive and a homemade apple pie at 2:20pm. He'll wait ~30 mins. Can we print a temp badge and sort storage for both?
frontdesk: Hi Rachel 80 we can print a visitor badge on arrival. For the pie  we'll need to chill it; can you confirm if it needs refrigeration?
rachel: I think it's room-temp pie but better cold. Also the vinyl box is marked 'fragile - records'.
ken: I can free up the small fridge shelf near the kitchen until 3pm. Tagging it "rachel - pie".
badge-bot: temp badge created: "Visitor - Rachel's Neighbor" (expires 15:00).
frontdesk: For fragile records, we'll keep the box on the low oak shelf in reception to avoid bending. If the box is heavy we can move it to the archive closet.
facilities: I can meet him at the front door and carry the box to the archive if needed. Leaving locker A1 free in case of oversize.
marta: @facilities thanks! Could you also bring a soft blanket to rest the records on if they're loose?
facilities: Yep blanket in the art closet. I'll bring it.
ken: Leaving a note on the fridge shelf now. Also have plates and a pie server by the kitchen.
rachel: Seating: he'll probably want a quick sit while he waits. Window bench or sunny couch?
frontdesk: Window bench is quieter and near the fridge. I'll reserve it and place a small "visitor" sign.
ken: I'll also prop the bench with a cushion.
rachel: Allergens: pie contains nuts (pecans). Please add a clear label and a sign on the table.
frontdesk: Will label "contains nuts" and keep pie on a covered plate in the fridge until serving.
facilities: Quick note: if records have loose sleeves, please don't stack them. We'll place them side-by-side on a low shelf.
marta: Who wants to host 10-min listening party at 3pm? :headphones: (kidding, but they sound vintage)
ken: Maybe later 60a
frontdesk: Also remind visitor to leave contact info when handing over archive donation form. We'll print the form at the desk and have him sign.
rachel: Thanks everyone  I'll tell him to bring the donation note and to confirm pie refrigeration.
facilities: Meeting him now, leaving the archive closet key with frontdesk.
badge-bot: badge printed for "Visitor - Rachel's Neighbor" ready at desk.
frontdesk: All set  badge on arrival, fridge label in place, archive closet reserved if needed. See you at 2:20pm."
